entries.text: CommentsOnTableRequired、CommentsOnColumnRequired、SpecificColumnsRequired、NumOfIndexesExceedThreshold 改为所有语句处理完成后执行
entries.textEn: CommentsOnTableRequired, CommentsOnColumnRequired, SpecificColumnsRequired and NumOfIndexesExceedThreshold now run after all statements are processed

entries.text: DDL 规则纳入 pawsql optimize
entries.textEn: DDL rules are included in pawsql optimize

entries.text: 所有 SQL 语句都生成 QueryAuditResult
entries.textEn: Every SQL statement produces a QueryAuditResult

entries.text: SQLAdvisor 中每条 SQL 语句都有 QueryAuditResult
entries.textEn: SQLAdvisor gives every SQL statement a QueryAuditResult

entries.text: SQL 解析器支持 comment 语句
entries.textEn: The SQL parser supports comment statements

entries.text: 修复 trim 函数解析与 QueryValues 的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed trim function parsing and QueryValues

entries.text: 修复 values 表查询分析与 SQL Server 关联表的计划分析缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed values-table query analysis and plan analysis for correlated SQL Server tables

entries.text: SQL Server 支持启用 SSL
entries.textEn: SQL Server: optional SSL

entries.text: FunctionChron 支持任意标识符作为值
entries.textEn: FunctionChron accepts any identifier as its value

entries.text: 优先从表引用匹配列，再检查伪列
entries.textEn: Columns are matched from table references first, then pseudo columns are checked

entries.text: 语法错误输出更准确的说明
entries.textEn: More accurate syntax error messages

entries.text: 支持 json_table 语法
entries.textEn: Added json_table syntax

entries.text: 修复查询中未定义表时选择列获取的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed select-list retrieval when the query defines no table

entries.text: 修复限定符解析与多表 update 语句 SQL 输出的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed qualifier resolution and multi-table update output

entries.text: 新增 aggfunction2 解析逻辑
entries.textEn: Added parsing for aggfunction2

entries.text: 优化汇总输出
entries.textEn: Improved summary output

entries.text: 语法错误输出改进
entries.textEn: Improved syntax error output

entries.text: 小幅调整
entries.textEn: Minor changes

entries.text: 修复 dateTimeFunctionCall 的语法缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed dateTimeFunctionCall syntax

entries.text: SQL Server 支持 for xml 子句
entries.textEn: SQL Server: for xml clause

entries.text: 支持 PLSQL_VAR
entries.textEn: Added PLSQL_VAR

entries.text: 不做性能验证时不再替换 SQL 中的参数
entries.textEn: Parameters are no longer substituted when performance validation is off

entries.text: findQuerySelect 支持在 If、Cast 等表达式中查找标量子查询
entries.textEn: findQuerySelect locates scalar subqueries inside If, Cast and similar expressions

entries.text: 修复 RuleOrCond4SelectRewrite 在只有聚集函数无分组语句时的重写错误
entries.textEn: Fixed RuleOrCond4SelectRewrite when only aggregates appear without a group by

entries.text: 过滤谓词下推支持下推到派生表
entries.textEn: Filter-predicate pushdown now reaches derived tables

entries.text: 查询折叠支持 lateral 子查询
entries.textEn: Query folding supports lateral subqueries

entries.text: 新增 RuleLateralQueryRewrite 规则
entries.textEn: Added the RuleLateralQueryRewrite rule

entries.text: 新增 ubtree 索引类型；允许 BUCKET 作为标识符
entries.textEn: Added the ubtree index type and allow BUCKET as an identifier

entries.text: MySQL 的主键列去重提前到索引去重之前
entries.textEn: MySQL primary-key column removal now runs before index deduplication

entries.text: 解析与输出支持外连接 (+) 写法，索引推荐中一并考虑
entries.textEn: The parser and writer handle outer-join (+), and index recommendation accounts for it
